title: Introduction to Error Handling
overview: Error handling is the process of identifying and managing errors in an application to prevent crashes and provide proper responses.

example.title: Error Handling Purpose
example.content:
Error Occurs
 ↓
Detect Error
 ↓
Handle Properly
 ↓
Continue Application

title: Try Catch in Node.js
overview: try-catch is used to handle synchronous errors by catching exceptions and preventing application failure.

title: Handling Async Errors
overview: Asynchronous operations require proper error handling using callbacks, promises, or async-await patterns.

title: Express Error Middleware
overview: Express provides special middleware functions to handle errors from routes and application logic.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to handle synchronous errors, asynchronous errors, and Express error handling techniques.
